name: Mirrored Stance
description: Stand with a mirror of qi at each shoulder so that a blow from either side meets glass.

name: Reflex Rap
description: Rap at the foe through a mirror so that the blow seems to come from a place the user is not.

name: Mirror Walk
description: Walk between two mirrors of qi and step out of whichever one the foe is watching.

name: Mirrorchain
description: Link a chain of mirrors that pass one image to the next until the foe cannot find the first.

name: Return Glass
description: Meet a strike with a pane of qi glass that throws its force back at the one who made it.

name: Image Hurl
description: Hurl an image of the foe's own thrown weapon back at him with a little more speed than he gave it.

name: Mirror Facets
description: Stand a rank of tall mirrors about the user so that every angle shows a different false user.

name: Glass Torrent
description: Shatter the whole rank of mirrors outward in a torrent of cutting glass-light.

name: Glass Verdict
description: Pass judgment on the foe by casting back at him the exact sum of the blows he has thrown.

name: Mirror Reign
description: The school's closing move that sets two great mirrors beside the foe and drives a blow between them that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Face Brush
description: Brush the user's features with a quick glamour so that the face a foe remembers is not the true one.

name: Visor Rap
description: Rap at the head from behind a visor of false light that hides the eyes and the aim.

name: Veiled Turn
description: Turn the face away under a veil so that the foe's blow lands at the place the face was.

name: Face Swap
description: Cast the face of the foe's ally over the user's own at the instant he sets his strike.

name: Mask Volley
description: Loose a volley of small masks that each bite with a point of qi as they strike.

name: Seamless Visage
description: Wear a visage so complete that blows aimed at the face of the likeness land on its false shell.

name: Mask Unpeel
description: Peel a forced likeness from an ally's face and mind so that he knows his own again.

name: Borrowed Identity
description: Take on the bearing and the voice of another so well that his own comrades follow the user.

name: Hundred Faces
description: Fill the air with a hundred faces that mock and strike at every foe in range.

name: Visage Absolute
description: Wear the face of the foe's deepest dread so truly that his mind takes the wound as real.

name: Twofold Unmasking
description: The school's closing move that strips the foe's sense of self and strikes the confusion with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Track Glaze
description: Glaze the foe's view with two overlapping images that run on parallel tracks.

name: Railed Strike
description: Strike along two lines at once so that the foe can block only the false one.

name: Rail Guard
description: Guide a blow along a rail of qi and off the body as it runs past.

name: Switch Pace
description: Switch from one track to the other in a stride while a copy stays on the first.

name: Phantasm Twin
description: Send one phantasm along each track so that the foe must split his attention.

name: Crossing Lance
description: Cross two lances of qi at the foe's heart so that a guard to one is open to the other.

name: Track Ward
description: Run a ward along both tracks so that a blow from either side is caught on the same shield.

name: Dual Reading
description: Read both tracks of a rival illusion at once to learn which one carries the true cast.

name: Convergent Seeming
description: Bring both tracks of the seeming to a single point in the field and burst it over all who stand there.

name: Railed Veil
description: Draw two veils across the field that never meet and never let a foe see the user's side.

name: Phantasm Junction
description: Join both tracks at the user's will and flash along the junction to any point in the field.

name: Great Dual Illusion
description: The school's closing move that joins two great illusions over the field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Core Glimmer
description: Draw a glimmer from the Core and set it across the foe's eyes as a bright false veil.

name: Crowned Strike
description: Strike downward with a hand wearing a crown of images that hide the fall of the blow.

name: Halo Guard
description: Ring the head and shoulders with a halo of images that scatters the aim of blows.

name: Seeming Cascade
description: Pour a cascade of seemings from the Core so that the field changes with each breath.

name: Core Lance
description: Fire a lance of Core qi dressed as a stray beam of light that pierces any guard.

name: Crown Reading
description: Count the images in a rival crown and find the one place where the pattern breaks.

name: Seeming Crown
description: Wear a crown of seemings that shows the foe a hundred rulers in place of one.

name: Hundred Falls
description: Drop a hundred images of the crown in a ring about the user and strike everything beneath them.

name: Coronation Veil
description: Crown the whole field in a veil so bright that no foe can look at the user and act.

name: World Crown Unveiled
description: The school's closing move that shows a hundred worlds crowning the field and drops them with a weight scaling to the user's reserve.

name: Oathbound Glaze
description: Lay a glaze sworn to the wind over the foe's eyes so that it holds against a blink.

name: Windward Rap
description: Rap from the windward side with a blow that the foe feels before he sees it.

name: Sworn Shield
description: Hold a shield sworn to the wind that does not fade while the user keeps the vow.

name: Sworn Walk
description: Walk inside a mirage sworn to the wind so that the foe tracks the vow and not the walker.

name: Vow Phantasm
description: Loose phantasms bound by a vow to their mark so that no dodge frees the foe from them.

name: Oath Mirror
description: Hold a mirror sworn to return what it receives to the one who sent it.

name: Vow Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally's mind of a forced oath or false memory by speaking the true one over it.

name: Oathbound Seeming
description: Swear a seeming to a stretch of ground so that any foe who enters it is held in its picture.

name: Vow Tempest
description: Raise a tempest of vowed phantoms that circles the user and strikes all foes within it.

name: Sworn Absolute
description: Break the foe on the oath he has made unwittingly by treating a false vow as real in his mind.

name: Oath Sealed
description: The school's closing move that seals the foe in an oath-sworn seeming that holds as long as the user's reserve allows.

name: Even Seeming
description: Spread a plain even seeming that flattens the foe's sense of height and depth.

name: Flat Rap
description: Rap at the foe at a distance he has been led to think is too long.

name: Even Guard
description: Hold the guard at an even height that shows the foe nothing about where it will move.

name: Misjudged Gap
description: Stretch and shrink the apparent gap between user and foe at the moment of every exchange.

name: Flat Lance
description: Drive a lance along a line the foe has been shown as flat open ground.

name: Truth Level
description: Set a plumb of qi in the field to learn the true height and slope of the ground.

name: Flat Lie
description: Lay one flat deception over the entire field so that every foe misjudges every distance.

name: Sudden Drop
description: Remove the false flatness all at once so that foes stagger as if the ground had fallen away.

name: Level Oblivion
description: Make the whole field seem empty and slip through the foes as through the air.

name: Lie Without Measure
description: The school's closing move that lays an unmeasurable lie over the field and breaks it with force scaling to the user's reserve.

name: Phantasm Draft
description: Stir a draft of phantasm round the foe's head that changes the look of everything near.

name: Gale-Held Palm
description: Strike with a palm sworn to the wind so that it follows the foe's dodge.

name: Tempest Guard
description: Raise a thin tempest of images at the guard that tears the force from a blow.

name: Rising Phantasm
description: Raise phantasms from the ground like dust devils that turn the foe's steps.

name: Tempest Shot
description: Fire a rank of bolts from the tempest that each seems a gust of dust.

name: Oath Lens
description: Swear a lens over the eyes and see only what is true within the length of the oath.

name: Veil Release
description: Release an ally from a veil of false pictures with a firm sworn word of qi.

name: Apparition Legion
description: Raise a legion of false dust devils that sweep the field and strike every foe they cross.

name: Airy Ward
description: Hold a guard with no wall at all that shows the foe open air and still turns every blow.

name: Tempest Law
description: Lay a law of phantom tempest on the field so that no foe may act against the sworn.

name: Tempest Sworn
description: The school's closing move that raises the sworn phantasm into a tempest and looses it with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Deep Glaze
description: Lay a deep glaze over the foe's sight that hides the user at any short range.

name: Oath Rap
description: Rap with a fist sworn to the dark behind the eyes where sight forms.

name: Inner Veil
description: Draw a veil of Core qi around the body that blurs every edge it touches.

name: Deep Pace
description: Hold the oath through a long step so that the copy left behind stays steady.

name: Sight Oath
description: Swear the sight of a whole company to a single false picture.

name: Pledge Lance
description: Loose a lance sworn to pierce whatever the foe believes to be solid.

name: Vow Bulwark
description: Raise a bulwark of vowed images that does not fall while the user keeps faith.

name: Waking Vow
description: Speak a waking vow over an ally that dispels every false picture from his senses.

name: Unbreakable Picture
description: Fix one picture in the senses of the foes so that none may look away or leave it.

name: Pledge Phantoms
description: Send a surge of vowed phantoms out from the Core that strikes every foe the oath names.

name: Sight Sovereign
description: Rule the sight of the whole field and press down every foe who tries to see otherwise.

name: Unbroken Pledge
description: The school's closing move that swears the whole field's sight to a single vow and holds it as long as the user's reserve allows.
